summary: Provides a pseudo Content Delivery Protocol that protects multiple source flows with one or more repair flows using the Forward Error Correction Framework and the SDP elements defined for it. It is not meant as a full protocol. It is informational.

eli5.summary: If some pages of a book can be lost in the mail, you can send extra repair pages. This memo shows how one set of repair pages can cover several books.

questions: repair flows for forward error correction
